versions.content: The DTC-specific Flash Amber Warning Lamp shall be set to Slow Flash (0x00) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the De- mIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemAmberWarningIndicator- Ref is set to DEM_INDICATOR_SLOW_FLASH .

The DTC-specific Flash Amber Warning Lamp shall be set to Slow Flash (0x00) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the De- mIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemAmberWarningIndicator- Ref is set to DEM_INDICATOR_SLOW_FLASH .

The DTC-specific Flash Amber Warning Lamp shall be set to Slow Flash (0x00) in case the corresponding event has set Lamp On and the De- mIndicatorBehaviour of the Indicator referenced by DemAmberWarningIndicator- Ref is set to DEM_INDICATOR_SLOW_FLASH .
